svg.title: Flank wear VB versus cutting time with the three wear zones and the end-of-life criteria
svg.text: Flank wear VB vs. cutting time – three zones and the tool-life criterion (schematic, example numbers)
Face mill Ø100 in EN-GJL-250, coated carbide K15–K25. Higher cutting speed = steeper curve = shorter life T. Criterion: VB = 0.3 mm (ISO 3685 / ISO 8688 test practice).
II steady (linear) wear – abrasion by graphite / carbides
The 180 m/min curve reaches 0.3 mm after 268 min (outside the chart). Lives from the Taylor example of chapter 6: C = 728, n = 0.25 [example].
Production criterion is often the PART (size, roughness, burr, spindle power), not VB – define it per tool in the tool list.
